info.name: Library Management — Login, Refresh, Logout
info.description: Local contract checks for login/logout. The access token is kept only in the collection runner's transient variables; the refresh cookie is managed by the runner cookie jar.

item.name: CORS preflight accepts the frontend origin and credentials

exec: pm.test('CORS allows the frontend origin', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Origin') === 'http://localhost:5173').to.be.true; });

item.name: Invalid login returns normalized credentials error

exec: pm.test('invalid credentials use the frozen error code', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().code).to.equal('AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS'); });

item.name: Admin login issues access token and HttpOnly refresh cookie

exec: pm.test('admin login succeeds', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code === 200 && body.code === 'AUTH_LOGIN_SUCCESS').to.be.true; });

pm.test('response contains only the access-token contract', function () { pm.expect(body.data && body.data.tokenType === 'Bearer' && body.data.accessTokenExpiresIn === 900 && !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(body.data, 'refreshToken')).to.be.true; });
pm.test('access token has a plausible JWT shape', function () { pm.expect(accessToken.split('.').length === 3 && accessToken.length > 32).to.be.true; });

pm.test('refresh cookie follows the local policy', function () { pm.expect(setCookie.includes('httponly') && setCookie.includes('samesite=strict') && setCookie.includes('path=/api/v1/auth') && setCookie.includes('max-age=604800') && !/(^|;\s*)secure(?:;|$)/i.test(setCookie)).to.be.true; });

item.name: Refresh rotates the cookie and issues a new access token

exec: pm.test('refresh issues a different access token without JSON refresh token', function () { pm.expect(accessToken.length > 32 && accessToken !== previousToken && !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(body.data || {}, 'refreshToken')).to.be.true; });

pm.test('rotation replaces the HttpOnly cookie for seven days', function () { pm.expect(setCookie.includes('httponly') && setCookie.includes('samesite=strict') && setCookie.includes('path=/api/v1/auth') && setCookie.includes('max-age=604800')).to.be.true; });

item.name: Admin logout revokes both credentials and clears the cookie

exec: pm.test('logout clears the refresh cookie', function () { pm.expect(setCookie.includes('httponly') && setCookie.includes('samesite=strict') && setCookie.includes('path=/api/v1/auth') && setCookie.includes('max-age=0')).to.be.true; });
pm.test('credential-free logout remains successful', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code === 200 && pm.response.json().code === 'AUTH_LOGOUT_SUCCESS').to.be.true; });

item.name: Demo member login works by username

exec: pm.test('demo member login succeeds', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code === 200 && body.code === 'AUTH_LOGIN_SUCCESS' && accessToken.length > 32).to.be.true; });
pm.test('demo member session logs out', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code === 200 && pm.response.json().code === 'AUTH_LOGOUT_SUCCESS').to.be.true; });
